segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Dana. I wanted to walk through the final order form for the 48 seats and make sure the onboarding dates still work before I send it back through deal desk.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sure. The seat count is right, 42 standard users and 6 admins. The main thing is we need the customer portal live by November 18, same as we discussed last week.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Right, November 18 for go-live. I do see the implementation coordinator sent you a December 2 kickoff, which is not what we agreed. Sorry about that, they had December 2 in their queue. I’ll get that corrected today and have them send a revised schedule.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay, good. Because our training blocks are already on the calendar for November 12 and 13, and moving those is kind of a mess.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Understood. I’ll have the services lead hold those dates. On pricing, the subscription is $43,200 for the year, plus the one-time setup fee of $3,800, and the 12-month term starts November 1.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That matches. But the invoice we got yesterday showed the full $43,200 due on receipt. We agreed quarterly billing with PO 7714 on each invoice.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, you’re right. Billing didn’t have the quarterly note, so that invoice went out wrong. I’ll have them void it and reissue four invoices for $10,800 each, net 30, with PO 7714.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Thanks. Also just confirm the 48 seats can flex up midterm. We may add 8 more in January if support likes it.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes, additional seats can be added prorated at the same unit price, no new term reset. If you remove seats, that would wait until renewal on October 31 next year.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Fine. Send the corrected invoice and the updated onboarding calendar, and I can get the order form signed by Friday.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. I’ll send the order form this afternoon and follow with the revised services calendar and invoice once those teams update their side.
